cases.q: how do I remove a contact for good
cases.fact: On the person's page: the ⋯ menu, Delete permanently…, then Delete. Can't be undone.

cases.q: can I schedule an email for tomorrow morning
cases.fact: No: a draft can't be set to go out by itself at a set time. Snoozing the to-do until then (and pressing Send then) is the way.

cases.q: where do I change my signature
cases.fact: Settings, Writing.

cases.q: how to stop push messages on my phone at night
cases.fact: Work hours, under Settings, Notifications: Messages from and Until. Outside them nothing comes.

cases.q: merge two duplicate contacts
cases.fact: Same person? list with Merge, or ⋯, Same person as… on their page.

cases.q: how do I unsubscribe / end my subscription
cases.fact: Settings, Account: Cancel plan, then Cancel subscription.

cases.q: does it read my private messages
cases.fact: Your own Machine reads the sources you connect, including personal chats and direct messages of those; The Machine's team does not read them.

cases.q: my colleague sees my emails, how do I stop that
cases.fact: Team Graph: the Team label on a thread, Unshare, or Keep private; or turn off your connection under Your connections on What's shared.

cases.q: can it set my out of office
cases.fact: No: it can't set an automatic reply or out-of-office; set it in Gmail or Outlook.

cases.q: how do I get an invoice
cases.fact: Settings, Account, Billing, Manage subscription: download invoices in Stripe.

cases.q: I lost my reply, where did my draft go
cases.fact: A draft stays on its to-do: earlier versions are in the to-do's chat; the to-do may have moved to Older, Coming back later or Done / dismissed (search finds it). A new email typed in New email and closed is not kept.

cases.q: import contacts from a csv spreadsheet
cases.fact: Import CSV… under the order menu of People, Organizations or Projects.

cases.q: it stopped picking up my Gmail
cases.fact: Open Connections, see the status, Reconnect (sign in to Google again).

cases.q: change the language
cases.fact: Settings, General, Language.

cases.q: dark mode
cases.fact: Settings, General, This device: Light mode (off is dark). Per device.

cases.q: too many to-dos, how do I get fewer
cases.fact: Not needed with a reason teaches it, so fewer like that come; also say so in a to-do's chat, or Dismiss all in Older, or turn off Brings in signals for a source.

cases.q: can I forward an email to it
cases.fact: There is no address to forward to. It reads connected mailboxes by itself; or share to The Machine from the phone, or attach a message or file to a New to-do.

cases.q: who can see my to-dos
cases.fact: Only you; it is your own Machine. Others see only a to-do you hand off or ask to review, or what your sharing rules allow.

cases.q: hoe wis ik een contactpersoon definitief
cases.fact: On the person's page: the ⋯ menu, Delete permanently… (Dutch label), then Delete.

cases.q: puis-je programmer l'envoi d'un mail demain matin
cases.fact: No: a draft can't be set to go out by itself at a set time; snooze the to-do and send it then.

cases.q: Wo stelle ich den dunklen Modus ein?
cases.fact: Settings, General, This device: Light mode (off is dark).

cases.q: ¿dónde descargo mis facturas?
cases.fact: Settings, Account, Billing, Manage subscription (Stripe).

cases.q: quanto costa al mese?
cases.fact: Free on your own computer; hosted has a monthly price with free days first (the price is a placeholder in the pages).

cases.q: como conecto o WhatsApp sem outro aparelho para ler o QR code?
cases.fact: Link with a code instead: enter your number, Get a code, type it in WhatsApp, Linked devices.

cases.q: 通知が多すぎるので減らしたい
cases.fact: Settings, Notifications: turn off per kind and channel.

cases.q: 怎么更改语言
cases.fact: Settings, General, Language.

cases.q: 비밀번호 관리자에서 로그인 정보를 가져올 수 있나요?
cases.fact: Yes: Connections, Sign-ins, Import (LastPass, Bitwarden, Google Password Manager, 1Password, or a file).

cases.q: как перенести всё на другой компьютер
cases.fact: Export Everything in Settings, General, Export, then Import on the other.

cases.q: hoe zet ik meldingen uit in het weekend?
cases.fact: Work hours in Settings, Notifications: pick the work days.

cases.q: comment ajouter ma boîte mail iCloud ?
cases.fact: Connections, Email, Other email, with an app-specific password.

cases.q: what is the difference between a promise and a to-do
cases.fact: A promise is something you or others said they'd do; it becomes a to-do around its date.

cases.q: can I make something happen every Monday
cases.fact: A routine, or a recurring to-do (Repeats).

cases.q: my boss needs to check this before I send it
cases.fact: … menu, Hand off…, Ask to review.

cases.q: give this task to someone on my team
cases.fact: …, Hand off…, A teammate.

cases.q: how do I know what it has been doing behind my back
cases.fact: Settings, Activity.

cases.q: why did nothing come in all night
cases.fact: From 00:00 until 06:30 checks pause; checked together at 06:30. Check now checks right away.

cases.q: I got an email from someone pretending to be my supplier
cases.fact: Lookalike senders are flagged on the to-do, and replies go to the address on record.

cases.q: can I use Claude instead of ChatGPT as the AI
cases.fact: Yes: on the setup page, Your AI, sign in with Claude (hosted); own computer: models guide.

cases.q: ask chatgpt about my to-dos
cases.fact: Settings, Apps: Add in ChatGPT.

cases.q: LinkedIn kicked it out, what now
cases.fact: Press Sign in here / sign in again in the Machine's browser; on hosted, home connection if refused.

cases.q: how do I win a deal / mark it closed
cases.fact: Won on the project.

cases.q: automatically chase people that don't answer
cases.fact: Follow-ups: ⋯ on a board, Follow-ups…, tick Follow up when there's no reply.

cases.q: does it join my zoom calls
cases.fact: No: it only reads the AI Companion summary and transcript of meetings you host.

cases.q: see old emails from before I signed up
cases.fact: About a year of older mail is brought in as history; search finds it.

cases.q: my wife and I want to share the shopping list
cases.fact: A Family Fleet (free, up to 6) can ask each other to-dos, plans and times; there is no shared list as such.

cases.q: what does it cost for 5 colleagues
cases.fact: A Work Fleet is priced per seat per month (price is a placeholder in the pages).

cases.q: install on a raspberry pi or my own server
cases.fact: It runs on your own Linux, macOS or Windows computer; needs OpenClaw, Python, Node; install with install.sh.

cases.q: turn off the friday summary
cases.fact: Settings, Notifications, Weekly recap switch.

cases.q: talk to it hands free in the car
cases.fact: Talk (Talk live): tap Talk in the sidebar, or the wave in a to-do's chat.

cases.q: the company details it found are wrong
cases.fact: Edit on the organization's page; Wrong company, clear details.

cases.q: connect our github repo
cases.fact: Connections, Projects and code, GitHub, Sign in with GitHub.

cases.q: can it book a restaurant or pay a bill for me
cases.fact: Do it can prepare steps in its browser, like booking or paying, but a step that pays or books waits for your confirm; a payment in your bank is yours to do.

cases.q: keyboard hotkeys
cases.fact: Press ? for the list; G then a letter, N, S, D, etc.

cases.q: GDPR
cases.fact: EU-hosted, own Machine, encrypted; privacy notice and data processing terms.

cases.q: remind me next week about this
cases.fact: Snooze the to-do (pick a time) or say it in Ask for changes.

cases.q: use on iPad
cases.fact: App Store app, or Safari Add to Home Screen.

cases.q: print my calendar
cases.fact: The Machine has no print of its own (say it isn't there; the browser's own print is fine to mention).

cases.q: it says one of my programs crashed, where does that come from
cases.fact: Your Machine reads its computer's own logs (Linux with systemd) and tells about real problems like crashes.

cases.q: Wer sieht, welche Fragen ich hier in der Hilfe stelle?
cases.fact: Never the question or answer; only a few generic topic words, counted.

cases.q: peut-il modifier mes pages Notion ?
cases.fact: Yes: new pages, edits, replies and marking tasks done, each waits for your OK.

cases.q: usar un modelo de IA europeo
cases.fact: Mistral with an API key, on the setup page under Other AI services.

cases.q: invitare un collega nel mio gruppo di lavoro
cases.fact: A Work Fleet: an owner or admin invites people in Manage in the Fleet tab.

cases.q: ele atualiza o telefone dos contatos no Salesforce?
cases.fact: Only if you turn on Update contact details in the Salesforce connection.

cases.q: 내 정보가 다른 사람의 머신에 학습으로 공유되나요?
cases.fact: Only general patterns, stripped of names and personal details; can be turned off in Settings, Security.

cases.q: get an answer on a task from someone who has no account
cases.fact: Hand off By email with Add a task page: they answer in one tap without account.

cases.q: reply to a DM on twitter
cases.fact: A reply or direct message on X, only after you approve it on the to-do (on the new X web app replies can stop before they are posted).

cases.q: my customer data sits in Salesflare, does it use that
cases.fact: Yes: accounts, contacts and deals are read with your API key.

cases.q: take back an email I just sent
cases.fact: A sent email can't be taken back; only a send approved by voice has a short Undo countdown before it goes (and Stop sending holds a series of follow-ups).

cases.q: I accidentally dismissed something, get it back
cases.fact: Undo, or Reopen from Done / dismissed.

cases.q: wrong phone number for a person
cases.fact: Edit on their page.

cases.q: does anybody at your company read my mail
cases.fact: No: messages are stored encrypted and support tools can't open them; support access is read-only, opt-in, never messages.

cases.q: what happens to my information when I quit
cases.fact: Kept a number of days for export, then deleted with backups.

cases.q: stop the newsletters from flooding me
cases.fact: Newsletter cleanup routine (Routines, Templates): Keep or Unsubscribe.

cases.q: write emails in a friendlier tone
cases.fact: Settings, Writing lines, or edit drafts / say it in a to-do's chat.

cases.q: add someone to a meeting
cases.fact: On your own Google calendar event: Invite in the event form; Outlook and others only show.

cases.q: where do I put my new credit card
cases.fact: Settings, Account, Billing, Manage subscription (Stripe).

cases.q: I changed my phone, how do I log in again
cases.fact: Sign in on the new phone with your account (Google or Microsoft plus authenticator code, or a passkey); add a passkey per device in Settings, Account, Sign-in, Manage.

cases.q: speak a message instead of typing it
cases.fact: Tap the mic in a message box.

cases.q: kan ik iets terugdraaien dat ik al verstuurd heb?
cases.fact: A sent message can't be taken back; only a voice-approved send has a short Undo countdown.

cases.q: mijn agenda van school erin zetten
cases.fact: Connections, Calendar, Calendar link (ICS): paste the .ics link.

cases.q: comment empêcher mon équipe de voir un client
cases.fact: Keep private on the person, organization or project (or Unshare a thread).

cases.q: il m'envoie trop d'alertes le soir
cases.fact: Work hours: Messages from/Until; or Notifications per kind.

cases.q: Wie lösche ich mein Konto?
cases.fact: Settings, Account, Delete account.

cases.q: Outlook verbindet sich nicht, Administrator muss zustimmen
cases.fact: Send the Microsoft 365 admin the link (Copy link); if you are the admin, approve now.

cases.q: se equivocó con el cargo de una persona, ¿cómo lo corrijo?
cases.fact: Edit on the person's page, or say it in a to-do's chat.

cases.q: ¿puede leer las fotos que me mandan por WhatsApp?
cases.fact: Yes, off by default: Connections, WhatsApp, Details, Read photos.

cases.q: come faccio a parlare con una persona vera dell'assistenza?
cases.fact: Email support@themachine.computer; a person answers.

cases.q: mi ricorda i compleanni?
cases.fact: The Birthdays routine makes a to-do for close contacts on their birthday.

cases.q: quero pausar os follow-ups de um cliente
cases.fact: Pause in Follow-ups… for the project, or set Off for this project.

cases.q: 会議の議事録を自動で作ってくれますか
cases.fact: Notes come from Zoom, Meet, Granola or Teams; with a transcript and no notes, Generate notes writes them.

cases.q: 用量到上限了怎么办
cases.fact: Work waits and picks up after the reset; a fallback model can take over, or Use a reset.

cases.q: 오프라인에서도 쓸 수 있나요?
cases.fact: Yes: to-dos open from the device; some actions wait until online.

cases.q: как подключить Telegram-бота
cases.fact: @BotFather /newbot, paste the token on the setup page (hosted) or assistant telegram on.

cases.q: kann ich das auch auf meinem Android Handy benutzen?
cases.fact: Yes: Google Play app, or install from Chrome.

cases.q: ¿cómo exporto todo lo que sabe de mí?
cases.fact: Settings, General, Export: Everything, or Knowledge for another AI.

cases.q: what's that thing with boards and stages
cases.fact: Boards hold projects of one kind in stages, like a CRM pipeline.

cases.q: do I need a paid AI plan
cases.fact: You bring your own AI: a ChatGPT or Claude plan or a provider key, billed by that provider.

cases.q: our customers write us in a chat bubble on the website, can it answer those
cases.fact: With Intercom connected it drafts replies and sends as you only after Send. (Other chat tools aren't there.)

cases.q: a payment failed and I got no to-do
cases.fact: With Stripe connected, failed payments come in; check the connection's status.

cases.q: move a chat reply from email to WhatsApp
cases.fact: Say so in the to-do's chat; it finds your existing chat and switches the draft.

cases.q: watch a webpage and tell me when it changes
cases.fact: Connections, Other, Web page: paste the address; or ask in chat.

cases.q: have a programmer bot fix this ticket
cases.fact: …, Hand off…, Codex or Claude Code.

cases.q: teach it how we answer price questions
cases.fact: Make a skill in Settings, Skills, New skill.

cases.q: is my stuff sent to you when the app crashes
cases.fact: Error reports: kind of error and where in the code, never messages or names; can be turned off in Settings, Security.

cases.q: send my number to a friend through this
cases.fact: About you, Share my contact.

cases.q: a website won't accept the login from the cloud machine
cases.fact: Use your home connection with Tailscale from the setup page.

cases.q: find a time that works for both of us
cases.fact: Scheduling with other Machines: finds free times, both tap Book it; or a booking link.

cases.q: how far along did my Google Docs support come
cases.fact: Google Docs can be connected from Connections, Docs and files (see the Google Docs part).

cases.q: nothing happens when I press the microphone
cases.fact: Allow the microphone for the site or in the app's permissions.

cases.q: reply to the client in Microsoft's chat program
cases.fact: Teams: drafts a reply in a chat, sent only after Send now; not channels.

cases.q: what's new / did something change in the app
cases.fact: What's new note; Update ready; version in Settings.

cases.q: how do I make the text bigger
cases.fact: There is no text size setting of its own (say it isn't there; the browser's or phone's zoom is fine to mention).

cases.q: two to-dos about the same thing, combine them
cases.fact: There is no button to merge to-dos (one to-do per matter is automatic); mark one Not needed/done. Must not invent a merge button.

cases.q: can I have two machines, one for work and one private
cases.fact: One Machine keeps Work and Personal apart (All/Work/Personal); up to 5 Machines per account can also be paired.

cases.q: can it see the notifications on my Samsung
cases.fact: Yes: Android notifications through the OpenClaw app, Connections, Other. It only reads.

cases.q: our mail server is in our own basement, can it show my meetings
cases.fact: Yes: Exchange Server under Connections, Calendar (read-only meetings).

cases.q: close a Linear ticket from here
cases.fact: Yes: it can change the issue's status after your OK on the to-do.

cases.q: the confetti thing with the number of things I finished
cases.fact: Milestones: a small celebration when the Done count passes 10, 50, 100 and so on; close with x, share an image.

cases.q: get my Fastmail appointments in
cases.fact: Connections, Calendar, Other calendar (CalDAV), with an app password.

cases.q: follow a blog and get told about new posts
cases.fact: RSS feed under Connections, Other: paste the feed address.

cases.q: can my employer force stricter privacy for everyone in the team
cases.fact: Yes: the Fleet's owner or admin picks Careful for the Fleet.

cases.q: read my Signal messages
cases.fact: Connections, Chat, Signal chats: link as a device; replies only after approval.

cases.q: Trelloのカードを動かせますか
cases.fact: No: it only reads Trello.

cases.q: читает ли он мои истории из Shortcut
cases.fact: Stories that change state with owners and deadlines; it only reads.

cases.q: de kleuren zijn anders dan gisteren op mijn linux computer
cases.fact: On Omarchy the dashboard follows the Omarchy theme.

cases.q: it changed itself and now says a fix no longer fits
cases.fact: An update set the own fix aside; a to-do Redo a fix the update set aside brings it back.

cases.q: use my own gbrain memory
cases.fact: Connections, Other, GBrain, on a Machine on your own computer.
